responsibility: This file implements core OpenVMS target runtime and assembly hooks outside the frontend. Its main job is to patch builtin and library references by creating transparent identifier aliases from standard C names to the appropriate VMS CRTL or DPML entry points based on pointer-size, malloc64, floating-point, and long-double modes using the generated vms-crtlmap table; it also supplies the target function-section policy and start-of-function output hook that emits VMS-specific symbols for main-program startup flags and optional debugger main-pointer support.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable VMS backend behavior for the shared vms stem: unlike vms.h, which declares target macros and hook wiring, and vms.opt, which declares the VMS option set, this file contains the code those hooks and options drive—rewriting builtin/library identifiers to VMS CRTL or DPML entry points and emitting VMS-specific function-start symbols and main-program flags.
